basic_info.chief_complaint: Food impaction in left upper back tooth for several days

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Food impaction in left upper back tooth for several days

oral_examination.oral_examination: 18 is elongated, the mesioproximal surface is carious and forms a hole, the mesial food is impacted, and the gingival papilla is red, swollen, and congested. Nothing special.

treatment_plan.notes: Strictly abide by the "Precautions after Tooth Extraction", take oral antibiotics (bring your own), and follow up with doctors if you feel uncomfortable.

source_handle: 8. Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding. Strictly abide by the "Precautions after Tooth Extraction", take oral antibiotics (bring your own), and follow up with doctors if you feel uncomfortable.
